verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its Data Access API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON document on SwaggerHub, and its developer portal reference is generated from that spec, with pages on pagination, rate limiting, authentication and versioning. The probe's 404s on docs.bugsnag.com candidate paths only show the spec lives on SwaggerHub instead; they do not contradict its availability. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec, and it is not discoverable at conventional paths on the main docs domain.
